verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.pipecat.ai (HTTP 200). Pipecat also provides agent-oriented docs: the CLI's context-hub registers a local docs/examples/API index as an MCP server for coding agents, and the quickstart scaffold writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and any documentation of llms.txt scope or contents beyond its existence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
context-hub (local docs/examples/API index built for coding agents)
Install the Pipecat CLI and scaffold the quickstart project (also writes AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md)
